issue_body:
# Performance below threshold — home and project detail pages (persistent, 4+ cycles)

Audited: **2026-10-03T13:23:04.691Z**

## Affected pages

| Page | Perf | LCP | TBT |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/` | 83 (was 85) | 3910 ms | 177 ms |
| `/projects/note-structurer` | 80 (was 82) | 4363 ms | 144 ms |
| `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` | 77 (was 79) | 4588 ms | 194 ms |

> `/about` (90) and `/projects` (89) remain comfortably above threshold.

## Why this matters
The two project detail pages have been below the 85 performance threshold for **at least 4 consecutive audit cycles** with no material LCP improvement. The home page briefly recovered to 85 last cycle but has dipped back to 83. LCP remains the dominant bottleneck across all three pages (~3.9–4.6 s); TBT is acceptable on all pages. This is a persistent structural issue, not noise.

## Recommended fixes
1. **Convert hero/LCP images to WebP or AVIF** with correct `srcset` / `sizes` to reduce initial payload on all three pages.
2. **Add `fetchpriority="high"`** to the LCP image element so the browser prioritises it earlier in the load waterfall.
3. **Preconnect or preload** critical third-party origins (fonts, CDN assets) that may be adding latency before LCP.
4. **Code-split** any non-critical JS bundles on project pages to reduce time-to-interactive and indirectly help LCP.

## Visual status
All pages are visually intact on desktop and mobile — no layout breakage, overflow, missing sections, or contrast issues detected.
